protocol.annual_fold: train through year-2; validate on year-1; trade test year
protocol.entry: next 15-minute market open in source replay
protocol.portfolio_gate: cap2 per scan, 3h symbol-direction cooldown, max4 same direction, pause after 3 losses

limitations: Cash-equity candles are structural transfer evidence for stock perpetuals.
The target and route configuration is selected from a finite grid and requires direct X-Perp forward confirmation.
Gross outcomes exclude fees at the user's request.
Historical results cannot guarantee future profit or eliminate losing months.
